run_train_instruct_pix2pix_lora: run the training script to fine-tune Stable Diffusion with LoRA for InstructPix2Pix image editing
create_lora_config_unet: create a LoRA configuration targeting attention projection modules in the UNet for parameter-efficient fine-tuning
run_validation_inference: run validation inference with the trained pipeline to generate edited images from a prompt and original image
save_lora_weights: save trained LoRA adapter weights for the UNet in diffusers-compatible format with safe serialization
save_model_card: save a model card README with example images, base model info, and dataset name for the trained LoRA adapter
